# install

First time: Install magic into a virtual environment.

```{bash}

set -euo pipefail
BASE="/mnt/bioinfnas/immuno/eprieto/Rmagic"
CONDA_DIR="${BASE}/miniforge3"
INSTALLER="${BASE}/Miniforge3-Linux-x86_64.sh"
mkdir -p "${BASE}"
cd "${BASE}"
# --- Install Miniforge only if missing or incomplete ---
if [ ! -x "${CONDA_DIR}/bin/conda" ]; then
  rm -rf "${CONDA_DIR}"
  rm -f "${INSTALLER}"
  wget --no-hsts \
    -O "${INSTALLER}" \
    https://github.com/conda-forge/miniforge/releases/latest/download/Miniforge3-Linux-x86_64.sh
  bash "${INSTALLER}" -b -p "${CONDA_DIR}"
  rm -f "${INSTALLER}"
fi
source "${CONDA_DIR}/etc/profile.d/conda.sh"
conda deactivate 2>/dev/null || true
if conda env list | awk '{print $1}' | grep -qx "magic_env"; then
  conda env remove -n magic_env -y
fi
conda create -n magic_env -c conda-forge python=3.11 pip -y
conda activate magic_env
python -m pip install --upgrade pip setuptools wheel
python -m pip install --no-cache-dir \
  numpy==1.26.4 \
  pandas==2.0.3 \
  scipy==1.11.4 \
  scikit-learn==1.3.2 \
  matplotlib \
  tasklogger \
  graphtools \
  scprep==1.2.3 \
  magic-impute==3.0.0
python -c "import sys, numpy, pandas, scipy, sklearn, scprep; print(sys.executable); print('OK', numpy.__version__, pandas.__version__, scipy.__version__, sklearn.__version__, scprep.__version__)"
python -c "from magic import MAGIC; print('MAGIC OK')"
# --- Install Rmagic ---
if [ ! -d "${BASE}/MAGIC/.git" ]; then
  rm -rf "${BASE}/MAGIC"
  git clone https://github.com/KrishnaswamyLab/MAGIC.git "${BASE}/MAGIC"
fi
R CMD INSTALL "${BASE}/MAGIC/Rmagic"

```
